credential.title: BYU-Idaho, United States
credential.description: Via BYU-Pathway Worldwide — covering financial analysis, bookkeeping, strategic management, business planning, sales, and marketing. A US-accredited degree, applied right here in Masaka.

points.title: Locally based — I come to you
points.text: Based in Masaka City. No Kampala travel, no waiting weeks for a response. WhatsApp or call and I respond the same day. I visit your business premises.

points.title: Priced for Masaka businesses
points.text: A Kampala accountant charges UGX 400,000–600,000 per month for basic bookkeeping. Zenith Tier 1 starts at UGX 150,000. Same professional quality, half the price.

points.title: Plain language. No jargon.
points.text: Every report is explained in plain language. You will always understand your own numbers — not just receive a document you cannot read.

points.title: Your information is private. Always.
points.text: Every client signs a confidentiality agreement. Your financial records are never shared with anyone — not other clients, not third parties, not anyone.
